notes.title: Version 1.0.0.4 (9/05/2017)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed level name staying after entering portal
[*]Adjusted hitboxes of Vine plants
[*]Added more checkpoints throughout the game
[*]Checkpoints saves crystal collection progress
[*]Credits volume abruptly stopping on exit
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.0.3 (8/14/2017)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where the level name stayed after entering the portal
[*]Adjusted the behavior of the spikes for One Way Out
[*]Shadows should now be visible on tree top platforms in the Wood Area
[*]Fixed lighting in the first three levels
[*]Fixed artifacts formed on the Scoreboard when graphics is set to High.
[/list]
